title: Tanshinone IIA, a component of the self-made Xiao-Yin decoction, ameliorates psoriasis by inhibiting IL-17/IL-23 and PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathways.
authors: Fu, Lei; Li, Meijiao; Wang, Peng; Chen, Lang; Huang, Jianqiu; Zhang, Hui
journal: Skin research and technology : official journal of International Society for Bioengineering and the Skin (ISBS) [and] International Society for Digital Imaging of Skin (ISDIS) [and] International Society for Skin Imaging (ISSI)
one_liner_zh: 该文研究丹参酮IIA治疗银屑病的抗炎机制，涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis is a persistent inflammatory dermatological disorder. Tanshinone IIA (tan-IIA) is a biologically active compound in the self-made Xiao-Yin decoction (SMXYD) and exhibits diverse biological properties, such as anti-proliferative and anti-inflammatory effects. The objective of this investigation was to assess the potential of tan-IIA as a therapeutic agent against psoriasis. METHODS: Network pharmacology was employed to ascertain the active constituents and potential pathways associated with SMXYD and psoriasis. We conducted CCK-8, qRT-PCR, and western blotting to assess the proliferation of HaCaT keratinocytes and the expression of IL-17/IL-23 and PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathways. Additionally, we used H&E staining, western blotting, and ELISA to evaluate the therapeutic effects and signaling pathways of tan-IIA in psoriasis-like mice induced by imiquimod (IMQ). RESULTS: Network pharmacology analysis identified eight hub compounds. The Th17/IL-17 signaling was found to be a potential therapeutic pathway of SMXYD against psoriasis, with JUN (AP-1) as the core molecule. Next, PTGS2 was selected as the target of tan-IIA against psoriasis using network pharmacology analysis. Molecular docking showed a high affinity between PTGS2 and tan-IIA. Tan-IIA treatment attenuated M-5-induced hyperproliferation and inflammation in HaCaT keratinocytes. Additionally, Tan-IIA downregulated the PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathway in HaCaT keratinocytes. In the IMQ-induced psoriasis-like mouse, tan-IIA significantly reduced the severity of skin lesions and downregulated the PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathway. Moreover, the combination of methotrexate (MTX) and tan-IIA further inhibited the IL-17/IL-23 and PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathways. CONCLUSION: The administration of tan-IIA has shown a positive effect on psoriasis by inhibiting the IL-17/IL-23 and PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1 pathways. The findings suggest that it has promising qualities that make it a potential candidate for the development of future anti-psoriatic agents.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病是一种持续性的炎症性皮肤病。丹参酮IIA（tan-IIA）是自制消银汤（SMXYD）中的一种生物活性化合物，具有多种生物学特性，如抗增殖和抗炎作用。本研究旨在评估tan-IIA作为银屑病治疗药物的潜力。方法：采用网络药理学方法确定与SMXYD和银屑病相关的活性成分及潜在通路。我们进行了CCK-8、qRT-PCR和western blotting实验，以评估HaCaT角质形成细胞的增殖以及IL-17/IL-23和PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1通路的表达。此外，我们使用H&E染色、western blotting和ELISA评估了tan-IIA在咪喹莫特（IMQ）诱导的银屑病样小鼠中的治疗效果和信号通路。结果：网络药理学分析确定了八种核心化合物。Th17/IL-17信号被发现是SMXYD对抗银屑病的潜在治疗通路，其中JUN（AP-1）为核心分子。接下来，通过网络药理学分析，PTGS2被选为tan-IIA对抗银屑病的靶点。分子对接显示PTGS2与tan-IIA之间具有高亲和力。Tan-IIA处理减弱了M-5诱导的HaCaT角质形成细胞过度增殖和炎症。此外，tan-IIA下调了HaCaT角质形成细胞中的PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1通路。在IMQ诱导的银屑病样小鼠中，tan-IIA显著降低了皮肤病变的严重程度，并下调了PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1通路。此外，甲氨蝶呤（MTX）与tan-IIA的联合使用进一步抑制了IL-17/IL-23和PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1通路。结论：tan-IIA的给药通过抑制IL-17/IL-23和PTGS2/NF-kappaB/AP-1通路，对银屑病显示出积极作用。研究结果表明，它具有有前景的特性，使其成为未来抗银屑病药物开发的潜在候选药物。
